units.source_text: 谈户口的事，我觉得比谈同感情有瓜葛的事要轻松得多。

en.t: I felt that talking about the household registry was much easier than talking about matters entangled with feelings.

units.source_text: 我打听了两三个道子同养父母家的关系问题，虽说这些问题我早已了解了。

en.t: I asked two or three questions about Michiko's relationship with her foster parents' family, although I already understood those things quite well.
